answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 297 Country: United States of America Title: Next year the elections will take place in USA. One of the candidates might be a lady and the other one may not be good to vote for. So in Islam is it jaiz to vote for a lady? And how about this situation, does it change anything? Question: Next year the elections will take place in USA. One of the candidates might be a lady and the other one may not be good to vote for. So in Islam is it jaiz to vote for a lady? And how about this situation, does it change anything? Answer ID: 297 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 431=425/B) There is a Hadith in Sahih Bukhari Sharif: لن یفلح قوم ولّوا امراةً (بخاري) It means that a nation can never succeed which chooses a woman as its ruler. Now, you yourself can decide in view of the Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
